title: Return Ceiling: Unopened Prescription Diet Returns and Tailwise Pharmacy Pharmacy-Placed Renewals
content:
*Pharmacy returns desk note.*

The days' supply per fill of a renewal Tailwise Pharmacy places by itself is no more than the return ceiling. The return ceiling counts the unopened prescription diet returns — return refund entries — on the renewed prescription's pharmacy ledger within the 12 calendar months ending on the renewal date.

| Unopened diet returns on the ledger within the 12 calendar months ending on the renewal date | Dispensed fills of the renewed prescription | Return ceiling |
|---|---|---|
| none | 4 or more | the class's maximum days' supply per fill |
| exactly one | 4 or more | the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill plus 15 days, never more than the class maximum |
| two or more | any | the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill |
| any | fewer than 4 | the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill |

## Worked cases (hypothetical; prescription written for 30 days, class maximum 90 days, renewal dated 2026-08-20)

- 7 dispensed fills, no return: ceiling 90 days.
- 7 dispensed fills, one unopened bag returned on 2026-03-11: ceiling 30 plus 15, 45 days.
- 7 dispensed fills, returns on 2026-03-11 and 2026-06-02: ceiling 30 days.
- 2 dispensed fills, no return: ceiling 30 days.
